draft.badName: Not an allowed property name. Names match {pattern} and are never sent to QRadar otherwise.
draft.required: Required: collection cannot run without it.
draft.valuesNoProperty: Values are assigned but no property is mapped for this field. Map the property first.
draft.valueInBoth: The value “{value}” is in both lists. Assign it to one.

catalogNote.notListed: Not in this console’s property list. Validation will check it.
catalogNote.wrongType: This property has no parsing expression for this source’s log-source type.
catalogNote.wrongTypeNamed: This property has no parsing expression for this source’s log-source type ({type}).

AVAILABLE.label: Usable
AVAILABLE.sentence: Populated, and the values look right.

NOT_MAPPED.label: Not mapped
NOT_MAPPED.sentence: No property is mapped to this field.

PROPERTY_REJECTED.label: Property rejected
PROPERTY_REJECTED.sentence: QRadar does not know a property with this name.

UNPOPULATED.label: Not populated
UNPOPULATED.sentence: The property exists but no event in the window carried it.

NO_EVENTS.label: No verdict
NO_EVENTS.sentence: The source sent no events in the window. This says nothing about the field.

QUERY_FAILED.label: No verdict
QUERY_FAILED.sentence: The check could not run. This says nothing about the field.

fieldStatus.unknownSentence: This build does not recognise this status; it is shown as recorded.
fieldStatus.implausibleMissing: The property is populated but its values do not look like this field.
fieldStatus.implausibleShare: The property is populated but only {share} of sampled values look like this field.

block.pending: Version {version} is still being validated. Enable becomes available when it validates as valid.
block.invalid: Version {version} validated as invalid. Fix the mapping and validate again.
block.inconclusive: Version {version} validated as inconclusive. Validate again when the source has events.
block.unvalidated: Version {version} has not been validated. Validate it first.

conflict.keep: Your edits are kept below; reload to see theirs.
conflict.changed: This mapping changed to {to} while you were editing{by}. {keep}

history.empty: No changes are recorded for this profile yet. Creating it, changing its mapping, validating it and enabling it each add a line here.
history.caption: Changes to this profile, newest first. Times are UTC.

form.copyNone: No other source has a mapping
form.copyFailed: The mapping could not be copied.
form.catalogFetched: Property list from this console, fetched <time></time>.
form.catalogApplies: Properties that apply to {type} come first.
form.catalogUnfiltered: It is not filtered by log-source type.
form.catalogDownTail: {lead} Type each name as QRadar shows it; validation checks it.

input.countNote: for “{query}”. The name you typed can still be used; validation will check it.

report.none: Version {version} has not been validated, so there is no report. Validation reads a bounded sample of this source’s events from QRadar.
report.stale: This report is for version {reportVersion}; version {version} has not been validated.
report.caption: What validation found for each mapped field. Shares are percentages of the events in the window.
report.pendingSince: Validating version {version} since <time></time>. This page checks every 5 seconds.
report.pendingNoSince: Validating version {version}. This page checks every 5 seconds.

values.notSeen: not seen in the last validation
values.notInList: Not in the last validation's list
values.empty: The last validation listed no {field} values. Validate the source while it has events to discover them; until then every value is unmapped.
values.truncated: This list is truncated: only the most frequent {field} values were returned. Values not listed count as unmapped, never as allowed.
values.caption: {field} values with their event counts in the last validation window, and the outcome each is assigned to.
values.addLabel: Add a value that was not listed
